title: Rav Huna of Sura
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Zevachim 91a](https://www.sefaria.org/Zevachim.91a.11) and [Keritot 10a](https://www.sefaria.org/Keritot.10a.3). Hyman reports that Shitah Mekubbetzet and Dikdukei Soferim read Rav Chanina of Sura in Zevachim. He also cites the Rosh, Hilkhot Ketanot, Hilkhot Mezuzah 10, where he disagrees with the Rabbis on Rava’s words.[^1]

notes.text: Both linked Bavli passages read Rav Huna of Sura. Hyman reports Rav Chanina of Sura as a variant in Zevachim.
